name: zero-downtime-schema-migration-p1
prompt: how can I add a NOT NULL column to a big table without locking it and taking the app down

chunks.content: standup: blocked on the staging seed data, will pair with Sam after lunch to unstick it
we will roll this out in two passes: first add the column as nullable with a default backfilled in batches, then flip it to required once every row is populated
the backfill walks the table 5000 rows at a time inside short transactions so we never hold a long write lock on the whole relation
adding the unique constraint on email rejected three duplicate accounts that had snuck in before validation existed
create the supporting index CONCURRENTLY so readers and writers keep working while it builds in the background
updated the ORM model to expose the new field, but kept it optional in code until the data is fully migrated
the old audit table was finally dropped after we confirmed nothing reads from it anymore, freeing a lot of disk
product cache entries are busted whenever a price write lands so customers never see a stale amount
set a 90-day lifecycle rule to move old export files to cold storage automatically
added a Grafana panel tracking p99 query time on the orders table
new signups get a verification email with a 24-hour token before the account activates
failed webhook deliveries retry three times with increasing delay before going to a dead letter queue
extracted the remaining hardcoded UI strings into the translation catalog for the German launch
the CI now fails the build if ruff reports any unfixed lint errors
